article.story: Wyoming (2-2) at North Dakota State (4-0), Oct. 3 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: North Dakota State by 20.5. Against the spread: North Dakota State 2-2, Wyoming 1-3. How to watch: The CW Key stats North Dakota State Offense Overall: 370.5 yards per game (89th in FBS) Passing: 211.8 yards per game (88th) Rushing: 158.8 yards per game (72nd) Scoring: 35.0 points per game (46th) North Dakota State Defense Overall: 254.8 yards per game (16th in FBS) Passing: 154.5 yards per game (14th) Rushing: 100.3 yards per game (31st) Scoring: 12.3 points per game (11th) Wyoming Offense Overall: 326.0 yards per game (120th in FBS) Passing: 165.8 yards per game (117th) Rushing: 160.3 yards per game (71st) Scoring: 17.8 points per game (132nd) Wyoming Defense Overall: 360.0 yards per game (79th in FBS) Passing: 176.5 yards per game (35th) Rushing: 183.5 yards per game (117th) Scoring: 20.5 points per game (48th) Wyoming is 134th in the FBS with a -6 turnover margin, compared to North Dakota State's 5th-ranked +7 margin. Wyoming is 99th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 80.0% of trips. North Dakota State's red zone defense ranks 1st at 55.6%. Wyoming is 101st in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:57, compared to North Dakota State's 32nd-ranked average of 32:17. Team leaders North Dakota State Passing: Nathan Hayes, 808 yards, 7 TDs, 2 INTs, 67.0 completion percentage Rushing: D.J. Scott, 225 yards on 50 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Jackson Williams, 283 yards on 18 catches, 1 TD Wyoming Passing: Tyler Hughes, 656 yards, 2 TDs, 5 INTs, 62.2 completion percentage Rushing: Samuel Harris, 226 yards on 42 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Kyle Frendt, 155 yards on 8 catches, 1 TD Last game North Dakota State defeated Sacramento State 31-10 on Sept. 19. Hayes passed for 210 yards on 14-of-24 attempts (58.3%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. Scott had 80 rushing yards on 14 carries and one touchdown, adding two receptions for 18 yards. Williams had seven receptions for 134 yards and one touchdown. Wyoming won 27-10 over Hawaii on Sept. 26. Hughes threw for 204 yards on 17-of-23 attempts (73.9%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. Harris had 94 rushing yards on 11 carries and one touchdown, adding four receptions for 36 yards. Deion DeBlanc had three receptions for 41 yards. Next game North Dakota State plays at UNLV on Oct. 10. Wyoming plays at San Jose State on Oct. 9.
